provenance.source: User-supplied USA Rev 2 ROM, executed with official libretro/Snes9x and local analysis bridge
provenance.musicEncoding: AAC 96 kbps stereo at 32000 Hz, lossy; streamed M4A
provenance.effectsEncoding: Original stereo PCM16 WAV, exact-zero trailing frames only trimmed with 40 ms guard
provenance.instrumentValidation: Each included SFX dependency matched complete ROM BRR bytes through actual ARAM DSP-directory mappings; water samples replace stale jungle-bank captures.
provenance.musicLoopPrecision: Repeated sequencer-state candidates at emulator frame boundaries, not sample-perfect PCM seams
provenance.captureInterventions: Built-in music-test flag and ID; SFX captures pause gameplay and redirect existing streams to authentic END opcode before real APU port commands.
provenance.aquaticBaseline: The three water SFX retain an observed residual PCM peak of 4/32768; no filter or normalization applied.
limits: Emulated audio, not physical SNES analog output.
AAC is lossy and resampled; it is not bit-identical PCM.
Loop candidates are unverified at sample precision; null does not prove a track has no loop.
Four-second SFX captures can truncate long or repeating sounds; names marked Unknown/Unused are not automatically appropriate gameplay events.
Sound names are annotations from the public USA 1.0 navigation source; all capture bytes derive from the verified Rev 2.
